requirements.requirement: 10 patients x 15 days of wearable data (10 pps device, 1 Hz gateway)
Medical rules: PS03 spec fixtures (NEWS2 bands, Scale 2, baseline, artifacts, alert lifecycle)
Continuous risk score decides by threshold (ML-1, raises to Review only)
Accurate: all deteriorations detected before severe, fewer false alerts than NEWS2
Evidence-based metrics with confidence intervals
Digital twin trained and forecasting 5/15/30 min on held-out patients
Twin uncertainty calibrated (RR band >= 90% coverage)
Blood pressure and HRV with scores and tests
SBP score false flags below 1 per patient-day
Urgent alert goes first to the patient's own doctor
Different patients route to different doctors (not one fixed doctor)
Doctor unavailable -> nurse
Nurse unavailable -> substitute doctor
Substitute unavailable -> management office
No acknowledgement: escalates through the whole chain, then reminds management
Different information to doctor, nurse, substitute and management
Phone/watch notifications carry criticality only
requirements.evidence: URGENT: Patient P003 needs attention. Open Avoflare when available.

requirements.requirement: Phone/smartwatch push delivery configured
requirements.evidence: NTFY_URL is not set: in-app inbox + browser notifications only; set NTFY_URL to deliver to phones/watches

requirements.requirement: Alarm sounds for every unacknowledged Urgent alert, for all clinical staff, until acknowledged
All supplied dashboard assets used (logo, avatars, watch stills and videos, login video)
Clinical decision support disclaimer present
Platform suite (FHIR, gateway security, roles, patient app, twin, BIDMC isolation, Doctor Ava, timeline, notifications)
Nurse can propose a medication (pending until a doctor decides)
Nurse cannot approve medication
Doctor decision requires a note
Doctor approves; second decision on the same request is refused
Approved medication appears in the patient's app
Doctor shift: start shift puts the doctor on duty
Shift view lists only the doctor's own patients with what happened (alerts, events, symptoms, medication)
Doctor signs off each patient review; cannot review another doctor's patient
Ending the shift takes the doctor off duty (escalations skip them)
Acknowledge and resolve are separate; resolve needs a doctor and a reason
